verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents guaranteed support response times, SLAs, or escalation paths for any Fly.io plan tier. The 'Run by Fly.io engineers, not chat bots' line has no stated support context. A community mention of a 'paid higher support tier' confirms only that tiers exist, not what they guarantee or how escalation works.
